record.apiChatParity: OWNER UI action, direct OWNER API route and central chat action registry use the same operationId and domain service; no UI-only writer.
record.audit: Every admission, transition, child reservation, outcome and manual-review decision records logicalOperationId, correlationId, actor/channel and before/after digests.
record.cancellation: Before commit: no change. After commit: reset outcome is canonical and cannot be cancelled; enrollment may be abandoned/renewed by its own state machine.
record.linearizationPoint: MFA reset epoch increment + prior factor invalidation + enrollment challenge creation in one DB transaction
record.purpose: Reset existing OWNER MFA only after current-session reauthentication, invalidate prior MFA/recovery material and enter bounded enrollment state.
record.recovery: Replay committed reset outcome by idempotency key; stale reauth or stateVersion requires refresh/new command.
record.terminalClosure: Reset transaction, audit and outbox committed; no old MFA factor remains valid.
